Proposals.Development: Ethan observes the executive's dominance and the super's irritation; he decides to leave but must pass their table. His proximity suppresses the super's powers, allowing the executive to escape while Ethan exits unaware of his role.
Proposals.Evidence: By the time he was abreast of the table the super was struggling. Elena had clawed at the hand on her head her nails leaving deep bloody gouges in the man’s hand and arm. David had got up far enough to slap at the super’s face. This time though it was one hard slap David brought all the way up from the table. This time the results were different the supers head rocked back. With David no longer face first in her asse Elena started kicking again. So just as the super’s head rocked back Ethan saw Elena's spiked six-inch stiletto heal embed itself right through the thin dress pants the man wore straight into the rather impressive bulge that had until that moment been growing in his pants.
Proposals.ProposedCurrentPhase: The bar incident has concluded with the executive's escape and the super's power loss. Ethan has left the scene without understanding the cause.
Proposals.ProposedNextMilestone: Develop the immediate aftermath of the completed bar incident in Chapter 2, while the cause of the power loss remains unknown.
